title: Pat Price remote views denied Soviet sites with gores and steel spheres

tellings.quote: not only reported on them with accuracy he talked about machinery and stuff there like a big Tower

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a former army psychic spy, told podcast host Jesse Michels about Pat Price, a fellow practitioner of remote viewing, the claimed ability to describe faraway places with the mind alone. McMoneagle says that in the early 1970s Price described closed-off Soviet sites accurately, down to machinery, a big tower and steel spheres. If true, it would mean the mind can spy on places no one is allowed to go.
